note: Lean states the first and last terms of the chain as the equality Nfl, which is what relative locality would impose; the middle equalities through Weyl operators W(h) are not in Lean, which has no Weyl operators and takes the equality directly as a hypothesis.

snippet.text:
def Nfl (F : Spec.Final C a S) (U : F.action.operators.H →ₗᵢ[ℂ] Ambient m) := ∀ (f : Test4) (h : TestList m),
    HasCompactSupport ⇑f → (∀ i, HasCompactSupport ⇑(h i)) →
    (∀ i, Probe.bar (h i)=h i) → (∀ i, Fields.causal f (h i)) →
    inner ℂ (coherent (-h)) (signal F U f)=inner ℂ (signal F U (Probe.bar f)) (coherent h)

proof_context.conclusion: The equality `<coherent(-h), signal f> = <signal(f̄), coherent h>` for compactly supported f and real compactly supported h causally separated from f.
